policy.rule: Every numeric figure must carry a denominator, scope, evidence class, source, and practical limit.

gad7_original.source: Spitzer RL et al. A brief measure for assessing generalized anxiety disorder. Arch Intern Med. 2006;166:1092-1097.
gad7_original.limit: Original development/validation sample; not an acute-emergency or diagnostic rule.

gad7_cochrane.source: Generalized Anxiety Disorder 7-item and 2-item scales for detecting anxiety disorders in adults. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews. 2025.
gad7_cochrane.limit: Accuracy varied across settings; a screen is not a diagnosis and cannot exclude a medical emergency.

breathwork_trial.result: All groups improved daily mood measures; breathwork, especially cyclic sighing, showed greater improvement in positive affect and reduced respiratory rate versus mindfulness meditation.
breathwork_trial.source: Balban MY et al. Brief structured respiration practices enhance mood and reduce physiological arousal. Cell Reports Medicine. 2023;4:100895.
breathwork_trial.limit: Five minutes daily for 28 days in a remote study; not proof that one sigh treats panic or makes alarming symptoms safe.

infertility_lifetime.denominator: adults over the reproductive life course
infertility_lifetime.source: World Health Organization. Infertility prevalence estimates, 1990-2021; current fact sheet and guideline reaffirm approximately one in six.
infertility_lifetime.limit: Lifetime population estimate, not the probability for one person or one attempt.

postpartum_psychosis.source: VanderKruik R et al. The global prevalence of postpartum psychosis: a systematic review. BMC Psychiatry. 2017;17:272.
postpartum_psychosis.limit: Methods were too heterogeneous for a pooled global estimate; rarity does not reduce emergency urgency when symptoms occur.

stroke_time_model.scope: typical untreated large-vessel supratentorial ischaemic stroke
stroke_time_model.source: Saver JL. Time is brain--quantified. Stroke. 2006;37:263-266.
stroke_time_model.limit: Order-of-magnitude model estimate, not a measurement in an individual patient; practical action remains FAST and 112.

household_water.source: Bundesamt für Bevölkerungsschutz und Katastrophenhilfe. Vorsorgen für Krisen und Katastrophen. Updated 2025/2026.
household_water.limit: Household drinking/cooking stock value; heat, illness, pregnancy, breastfeeding, work, pets, and hygiene can require more.

sleep_restriction.result: The four- and six-hour chronic-restriction conditions produced cumulative, dose-dependent cognitive-performance deficits; subjective sleepiness rose less clearly than objective impairment.
sleep_restriction.source: Van Dongen HPA et al. The cumulative cost of additional wakefulness. Sleep. 2003;26:117-126.
sleep_restriction.limit: Small controlled study in healthy adults aged 21-38; the chronic-restriction arms lasted 14 days and the zero-hour comparator 3 days. Use as a warning about cumulative impairment, not a personal calculator.

social_connection_mortality.source: Holt-Lunstad J et al. Loneliness and social isolation as risk factors for mortality: a meta-analytic review. Perspect Psychol Sci. 2015;10:227-237.
social_connection_mortality.limit: Adjusted associations across longitudinal studies; they do not prove that one state directly caused one death or predict an individual's future.
